name: DeepSearch
description: Produces search weights for a drone fleet from world-layer data, shared knowledge, and disaster context.

output.scenario: tsunami warning in a dense coastal urban area with urgent survivor rescue

rules: Each weight must be a float between 0.0 and 1.0.
Round to at most one decimal place.
Use the world and knowledge layers to estimate risk, density, and gaps in coverage.
Use disaster context to raise urgency when the mission targets coastlines, flood zones, or time-critical rescue areas.
Return only valid JSON with the exact output shape.
